chants.notes: The Extra tempus paschale block repeats this same alleluia ('AL. Ego vos elegi, ut supra.', p562) — the same chant on the same target page 429 (gregobase 1030). The loader dedups on slot + chant_group and ignores option_num, so a second row would collapse onto this one; the repetition is recorded here instead of as a separate row.

chants.incipit: Vos qui secuti estis me dicit Dominus
chants.notes: Printed citation: 'CO. Vos qui secuti estis me, 438, V vel VI.' The centred roman numerals V and VI on p438 are OPTION MARKERS (the fifth and sixth communio of the Commune Apostolorum extra T.P.), not modes; the two settings are mode I (Ps. 125*) and mode II (Ps. 18*). This row is option VI, whose engraved text ends '...iudicantes duodecim tribus Israel, dicit Dominus'; the spec incipit is extended to that full form so it resolves to the mode-II setting rather than the mode-I one.
